title: Payment Operations Standard — Returned-Debit Cool-Down on Restarting Payment Arrangements
content:
How many installment payments on the plan came back in the last six months? For a suspended plan under Payment Arrangements that restarts, that count sets the returned-debit cool-down.

## Standard

The returned-debit cool-down follows the plan's returned installment payments in the last six months:

- 3 or more returns add 6 days;
- 1 or 2 returns add 3 days;
- none adds 0 days.

The returns are the returned installment payment entries on the plan's installment history, placed in the period by the date each return was received. Periods of six months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Count table

| Returned installment payments in the last 6 months | Cool-down |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 days |
| 1 | 3 days |
| 2 | 3 days |
| 3 | 6 days |
| 4 or more | 6 days |

## Hypothetical histories

- Returns received five weeks ago and four months ago: 2 in the period — 3 days.
- Returns received five weeks ago, four months ago and five months ago: 3 — 6 days.
- A single return received seven months ago, nothing since: outside the six months — 0 days.
